name: Roasted Broccoli and Cauliflower with Lemon Tahini
steps: Roast the vegetables with the oil at 425°F for 22 minutes.
Drizzle with tahini whisked with lemon, garlic and water.

name: Parmesan Crusted Roasted Tomatoes
steps: Halve the tomatoes and top with garlic, parmesan and oil.
Roast at 400°F for 22 minutes and finish with basil.

name: Chili Lime Roasted Sweet Potato Wedges
steps: Toss the wedges with oil and chili powder and roast at 425°F for 28 minutes.
Finish with lime and cilantro.

name: Garlic Butter Green Beans and Mushrooms
steps: Sauté the mushrooms in butter with garlic.
Add the blanched beans and cook 3 minutes; finish with parsley.

name: Sesame Garlic Bok Choy
steps: Sauté the garlic in sesame oil, add the bok choy and soy sauce.
Cook 4 minutes and top with seeds.

name: Tomato Cucumber Avocado Salad
steps: Toss everything with lime and oil.

name: Baked Parmesan Asparagus Fries
steps: Dip the spears in egg, then almond flour and parmesan.
Bake on an oiled tray at 425°F for 12 to 15 minutes.

name: Cinnamon Roasted Butternut Squash Cubes
steps: Roast the cubed squash with oil, cinnamon and salt at 425°F for 28 minutes.
Top with pecans.

name: Garlic Herb Brown Rice
steps: Warm the cooked rice with garlic softened in oil.
Fold in parsley and lemon.

name: Sauteed Zucchini and Yellow Squash with Basil
steps: Sauté the squash and garlic in oil 8 minutes.
Finish with basil and parmesan.

name: Marinated Cucumber and Onion Salad
steps: Slice the vegetables and toss with the vinegar, dill and sweetener.
Chill 30 minutes.

name: Baked Apple Slices with Cinnamon and Oats
steps: Toss the sliced apples with cinnamon and place in a dish.
Top with oats, butter and walnuts and bake at 375°F for 25 minutes.

name: Chocolate Dipped Banana Bites
steps: Slice and freeze the banana.
Dip in melted chocolate and sprinkle with walnuts.

name: Ricotta Parfait with Peaches and Almonds
steps: Layer the sweetened ricotta with sliced peaches.
Top with almonds and cinnamon.

name: Strawberry Cheesecake Overnight Chia
steps: Whisk the milk, cream cheese, chia and vanilla and chill overnight.
Top with strawberries.

name: Peanut Butter Protein Brownies
steps: Blend everything until smooth.
Bake in a lined pan at 350°F for 22 minutes.

name: Orange Almond Flour Cake Bites
steps: Whisk the eggs, zest and juice with the sweetener and vanilla.
Fold in the almond flour and baking powder.
Bake in a mini tin at 350°F for 16 to 18 minutes.

name: Frozen Berry Yogurt Cups
steps: Stir the sweetened yogurt with crushed berries.
Spoon into cups, top with almonds and freeze 3 hours.

name: Cocoa Almond Butter Energy Balls
steps: Mix everything, roll into twelve balls and chill.

name: Spiced Rooibos Iced Tea with Orange
steps: Steep a strong spiced tea, chill, and add the orange and stevia.

name: Pineapple Spinach Yogurt Smoothie
steps: Blend everything with ice.

name: Vanilla Almond Milk Latte
steps: Froth the warmed almond milk with vanilla and sweetener.
Pour over the coffee.

name: Blackberry Basil Sparkler
steps: Muddle the berries with basil and lime.
Top with sparkling water over ice.

name: Mocha Protein Smoothie
steps: Blend everything with ice.

name: Warm Cinnamon Vanilla Milk
steps: Warm the milk with cinnamon, vanilla and sweetener and whisk.

name: Cucumber Mint Green Smoothie
steps: Blend everything with ice.

name: Raspberry Almond Milk Shake
steps: Blend with ice.

name: Peanut Butter Cup Protein Shake
steps: Blend with ice.

name: Smoky Roasted Garlic White Bean Mash
steps: Roast the garlic until soft.
Mash with the beans, oil, paprika and lemon and finish with parsley.
